claims.claim: The source argues nonabsorption for an unchanged genuinely productive agent joined by an equal contributor.
claims.qualification: High confidence; argumentative truth remains separately appraised.

claims.claim: Complete power and decisive will are explicitly taken to entail production through the agent alone.
claims.qualification: Not merely ordinary outcome entailment; its universal application is the target bridge.

claims.claim: Intrinsic attributes, harmless concomitance and efficient donation are distinct in the source.
claims.qualification: Does not automatically license plural intrinsically concordant originals; prevents correlation being identified with donation without argument.

claims.claim: Efficacy is a perfection, and externally supplied constitutive perfection conflicts with intrinsic necessity.
claims.claim_type: source argument with positive philosophical warrant
claims.qualification: Substantial warrant; shared actual realization must still be shown to constitute receipt of intrinsic perfection.

claims.claim: The source considers intact original capacities and rejects efficacy dependent on peer enabling/noninterference.
claims.qualification: The strongest rival denies blockage of Q or its own end; absence of exclusive provenance is the remaining disputed perfection.

claims.claim: The external product can contain two effects, distinct from the two agents intrinsic acts.
claims.qualification: Strong support for contribution-sensitive ontology, not independent proof of fresh per-root sole-owned preserving tokens or locality.

claims.claim: Contingent coalescence requires a doer, but joint-doer exclusion uses the prior cooperation exclusion.
claims.qualification: A direct joint efficient explanation cannot be rejected by reifying its law into an unexplained third maker.

claims.claim: Means can have additional goods even where a selected endpoint is directly attainable.
claims.qualification: Blocks endpoint-only futility objection; does not validate this coalescent original act.

claims.claim: Continued production/preservation is a fuller form of agency than merely supplying a condition or initiating the product.
claims.claim_type: direct source reconstruction and positive warrant
claims.qualification: Ibn Rushd quoted then Ibn Taymiyyah explicitly assents in the qualified proper sense.

claims.claim: Preservation does not by itself imply a fresh, separately source-owned external token for each preserving root.
claims.qualification: No inspected passage supplies that individuation; no global absence claim.

claims.claim: The trace reduction is valid under real manifestation, locality, disjoint whole-token attribution and faithful retention.
claims.qualification: The theorem source was read; no new kernel replay. The source does not independently discharge every premise for co-preservers.

claims.claim: The improved rival concedes relational coproduction but not efficient receipt of intrinsic power, cognition, act or own end.
claims.qualification: Reduced-signature affirmative credit; no metaphysical-possibility certificate.

claims.claim: An additional intrinsic original act cannot simply be counted as an additional created-output trace.
claims.qualification: Creating and created product remain distinct.

claims.claim: Knowledge-fixed nonoccurrence is distinct from intrinsic impossibility and lack of standing power.
claims.qualification: Supports relevant-resource suppression comparison; not a possible-world certificate preserving all knowledge and policy facts.

claims.claim: Essential genus of efficacy is distinct from each particular act and product.
claims.qualification: Optionality alone does not vindicate a defective exercise; particular relational completion is not automatically an essential intrinsic perfection.

claims.claim: Wise activity and a loved end realized at the fitting time are not deficient merely because the end newly occurs.
claims.qualification: Positive authorial claims separated from opponent-relative/arguendo replies8–9; does not establish goodness of the particular coalescent act.

claims.claim: A defeasible preference for one actual common original source remains reasonable while universal exclusion of the improved rival is not established.
claims.qualification: Positive complete-provision basis; rival improvements weaken older dismissal grounds. This is confidence appraisal, not a deductive theorem or closure.
